def luhn_valid(number: str) -> bool:
    digits = [int(c) for c in number]
    checksum = 0
    parity = len(digits) % 2
    for i, d in enumerate(digits):
        if i % 2 == parity:
            d *= 2
            if d > 9:
                d -= 9
        checksum += d
    return checksum % 10 == 0
